content.summary: The inherited degree cap is correctly attributed and applied. Its actual hypotheses match the 28-member intersecting rank-four sunflower-free families used here, without requiring I(27) or either boundary exclusion. No source-mapping repair is required for this input. I verified the fresh snapshot and manuscript hashes and manifest hashes of all four inspected Lean modules.

checks.observation: The source derives degree at most nineteen from degree at most twenty and the theorem that degree twenty forces family cardinality twenty. Its premise is cardinality at least twenty-one. Each support assembly supplies cardinality twenty-eight and the required uniformity, sunflower-freeness, and intersection hypotheses. The manuscript's named source and numerical cap match this chain; the reviewed applications contain no extra exclusion assumption.
